frontmatter.title: Data Visualization: Pros and Cons of D3.js
frontmatter.subheading: A comparison of two powerful data visualization libraries
frontmatter.excerpt: D3.js remains the gold standard for bespoke web visualizations in 2026. However, its low-level nature and steep learning curve aren't for everyone. Explore the brutal truths about its performance, flexibility, and why it might be total overkill for your next project.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
